maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from pharmacy prescription discount fees, subscriptions and pharma manufacturer advertising, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by pharmacy benefit managers, consumers' subscriptions and pharmaceutical manufacturers, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through its consumer prescription savings marketplace and subscriptions; acquisitions like HealthiNation and Scriptcycle are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch to competing discount cards or coupons; no retraining or qualification needed.
